articles.title: Prediction markets inch closer to the Supreme Court: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: New Jersey petitioned for a writ of certiorari in Kalshi's case against it last week, finally throwing the ball to the high court.

articles.title: Ukrainian police took down a crypto scam that stole up to $1 million a month
articles.snippet: Investigators have identified 62 victims and say more than 46 Ukrainians took part in the alleged operation.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tumbles after blowout August jobs print
articles.snippet: Net assets in spot bitcoin ETFs crossed $103 billion for the first time, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for well over half the money.

articles.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

articles.title: US law enforcement group moves to ‘neutral’ position on CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: Despite earlier opposition to the CLARITY Act over consumer protection, the National Sheriffs’ Association says it will now “step back and allow the legislative process to proceed.“
